name: Illustrate new bonus stories and publish them on WordPress
description: When the author drops a new story into the bonus folder, gets it illustrated, formats it like the book and publishes it quietly on the buyers-only bonus page, then updates the bonus counter.
shortDescription: When a new bonus story lands in Google Drive, illustrate it, format it and publish it on WordPress.
keyFeatures: Google Drive trigger on a bonus stories folder
AI layout editor that formats the story like the book
Publishes on WordPress and logs the story to a spreadsheet
prerequisites: Google Drive, Google Docs and Google Sheets connections
WordPress connection; replace REPLACE_WITH_BONUS_CATEGORY_ID with the bonus page category
The Illustrate a story template imported and published in the same project; replace REPLACE_WITH_ILLUSTRATOR_WORKFLOW_UUID
A Google Drive folder for bonus stories; replace REPLACE_WITH_BONUS_FOLDER_ID
idealFor: Authors who keep publishing new stories for readers who already bought the book.
steps: Trigger: a new file appears in the bonus folder in Google Drive.
Read the story from Google Docs.
The layout editor agent formats the story like the book.
Log the story to Google Sheets.
